notes: Boot harl_a40 with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, with PinMAME's built-in motorcycle mechanism enabled (--handle-mechanics 1: harley_handleMech moves the bike while solenoid 19 is on and writes 35/36), so the scenario never writes 35 or 36. Insert three coins on the center slot (public 5), press Start (54), emulate the serve (trough position 11 empties, the ball rests on the shooter lane switch 16, the Launch button 53 is pressed and the ball leaves), close each playfield switch once with a 3 s gap so every output response is attributable to one closure, knock down each 4-bank in turn and leave it down until its reset, hold the super VUK and the power scoop, pulse the motorcycle enter opto 37 and then rest a ball on the bottom of the motorcycle kick-out trough 44, hold the right cabinet button 8, hold each flipper button, and drain the ball.
